item.name: Private Clothing Optional Charter
item.description:
#The Florida Keys and Key West are renowned for their natural beauty, vibrant culture, and adventurous spirit. 

As part of this rich tapestry, we are excited to announce a new addition to our charter offerings: clothing-optional private boat charters. This unique experience allows you to embrace freedom and connect with nature in a way few other activities can offer.

#Start times are flexible upon request. 

#Why Choose Six Fins Charter for a Clothing-Optional Private Boat Charter?

1. Ultimate Freedom and Relaxation

Imagine sailing through the crystal-clear waters of the Florida Keys, feeling the gentle breeze on your skin without the constraints of clothing. Clothing-optional charters provide an unparalleled sense of liberation and comfort, enhancing the overall relaxation of your journey.

2. Exclusive and Private Experience

Our clothing-optional charters are designed for privacy and exclusivity. Whether celebrating a special occasion, looking for a unique adventure, or simply wanting to unwind, our private charters ensure you have the space and freedom to enjoy the experience on your terms.

3. Connect with Nature

Being on the water is a powerful way to connect with nature, and doing so without clothing intensifies this connection. You can feel the sun, sea, and wind more intimately, allowing you to appreciate the stunning marine environment around you more deeply.

4. Perfect for Groups and Couples

Our clothing-optional charters are ideal for both groups and couples. Whether you’re a couple seeking a romantic getaway or a group of friends looking for a memorable adventure, our charters provide a safe and respectful environment for everyone.

5. Unforgettable Memories

A clothing-optional boat charter is a unique and memorable experience. The adventure stands out, creating stories and memories you’ll cherish forever. From sunbathing on deck to swimming in secluded coves, every moment is an opportunity for a new, liberating experience.

What to Expect on Our Clothing-Optional Charters

- Professional and Respectful Crew: Our crew is trained to provide a professional, respectful, and discreet service to ensure your comfort and privacy throughout the journey.

- Customizable Itineraries: Tailor your charter to your preferences, whether exploring hidden coves, snorkeling, or simply relaxing on deck.

- Comfort and Amenities: Our Jeanneau NC Weekender 895 has all the amenities you need for a comfortable and enjoyable trip, including refreshments, sunbathing areas, and snorkeling gear.

- Stunning Locations: Explore the beautiful and secluded spots of the Florida Keys, away from the crowds and fully immersed in nature.

##Complimentary
All charter passengers may use The Perry Hotel and Marina pools & gym as my guests before and after the charter. David, Owner

Book Your Clothing-Optional Charter Today!
item.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT ACTION REQUIRED

Six Fins Charter – Clothing-Optional Private Charter Confirmation

Dear Guests,

We’re honored to host your private clothing-optional charter aboard Six Fins Charter.

The Florida Keys are known for freedom, natural beauty, and open water — and your private yacht experience is designed with discretion, privacy, and professionalism at its core.

Please carefully review the important details below to ensure a seamless and comfortable day on the water.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

✅ Before Your Charter

For trips up to six passengers:

👉 Each passenger must complete the insurance waiver (including adults on behalf of minors): [here] (https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/rd9k5tiavpwper7h2rhaqh/web/)

AND for trips with 7th and 8th passengers:

👉 The primary renter (21+ years old) and captain must complete the Bareboat Agreement together at the dock before departure, but prior to arrival, you may begin: [here](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/ez5636zbxexwrng7dtz6mq/web/)

All forms must be completed in advance so we may depart on time.

A valid government-issued photo ID is required at check-in.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🌊 Your Private Charter

You’ve reserved a private custom charter for:

6 Hours – $1,295
8 Hours – $1,445
10 Hours – $1,670

Your itinerary is customizable and may include:

• Secluded sandbar anchorage
• Relaxed coastal cruising (Gulf or Atlantic side)
• Swimming & floating
• Snorkeling (upon request)
• Scenic harbor touring
• Sunset cruising (extended charters)

This is not a public tour — it is your private yacht experience with a professional, discreet captain.

Clothing-optional participation is entirely voluntary and never required.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🛥 Departure Details

Dock A, Slip #32
7001 Shrimp Rd
Stock Island, FL 33040

Free parking is available adjacent to The Perry Hotel & Marina.
Please arrive 15 minutes prior to departure.

Vessel:
30' Jeanneau NC 895 Weekender
Private enclosed head (toilet)
USCG-certified safety equipment
Licensed USCG captain

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🧳 What’s Included

• Cooler with ice
• Bottled water
• Adult noodles
• Snorkel gear (upon request)
• Lily pad & paddleboard (upon request)

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🚫 Not Included

• Meals & alcoholic beverages (BYOB welcome)
• Towels
• Infant/toddler USCG-approved life jackets (must be provided by guest)
• Captain gratuity (customary 20% minimum if satisfied)

Open flames (candles, cigars, sparklers, etc.) are not permitted onboard.

Illegal substances are strictly prohibited.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🩺 Health & Safety

Your safety and comfort are our highest priority.

• Operated by U.S. Coast Guard–licensed captains
• Mandatory safety briefing prior to departure
• Life jackets available for all guests
• Routes selected based on weather, tides, and privacy considerations

• Food allergies or dietary restrictions: reply to this email and let us know in advance so we can prepare.
• Prone to seasickness: tell us ahead of time and we'll suggest what to take before boarding.

Excessive intoxication, unsafe behavior, or inappropriate conduct may result in denial of boarding or early termination without refund.

Guests entering the water should be comfortable around water and in good general health.

Guests with heart conditions, mobility limitations, pregnancy concerns, or sun sensitivity should consult a physician prior to booking.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

⚠ Disclaimers

• Itinerary subject to weather, tides, and captain discretion
• Privacy cannot supersede compliance with maritime law
• Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed
• Late arrivals may reduce charter time
• Six Fins Charter is not responsible for lost or damaged personal belongings
• Inappropriate or unlawful behavior will result in immediate termination without refund

This experience is intended for respectful adults who value discretion and a comfortable atmosphere.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

🎁 Complimentary Access

As my charter guests, you may enjoy access to The Perry Hotel & Marina pools and fitness center before and after your charter.

Make it a full day of relaxation.

――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――――

We look forward to welcoming you aboard for a private and liberating day on the water.

Warm regards,

David McFadden
Owner, Six Fins Charter

item.cancellation_notes:
Enjoy peace of mind with our cancellation policy:

All reservations made within 7 calendar days of departure are non-refundable. Customer cancellations made prior to 7 calendar days before departure will receive a full refund. If Six Fins Charter cancels due to unsafe weather conditions or other circumstances initiated by the owner/operator, the customer will receive a full refund.
